history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help me get it working again?

I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing no service on your phone. Let's try to get this resolved for you!

To assist you better, could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your line
- Your full name and date of birth (for verification)

This will help me locate your account and check the status of your line.
Sure, my name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send messages or use data.

Would you like me to resume your line now so your service can be restored? If you know the reason for the suspension (for example, if it was due to a missed payment or a request you made), please let me know, or I can proceed to reactivate it for you.
Yes, please go ahead and resume my line so I can get my service back. I'm not sure why it was suspended.

Your line has been resumed and is now active. You should regain service shortly—please restart your phone if you don't see bars or service within a few minutes.

If you continue to have issues or need further assistance, let me know!

response.result: Line LN-8830142 has been resumed and is now Active.

history.content: I restarted my phone as you asked, but I still have no service—there are no signal bars and nothing is loading.

Thank you for restarting your phone. Since your line is now active and your device appears to be properly activated, but you still have no service, let's try a few more troubleshooting steps:

1. Double-check that Airplane Mode is turned off.
2. Try removing and reinserting your SIM card (or, if you use eSIM, try toggling the mobile network off and on).
3. Make sure your phone is set to automatically select the network (Settings > Network & Internet > Mobile Network > Automatically select network).
4. If possible, test your SIM card in another phone to see if it works there.

If you've tried these steps and still have no service, please let me know. I can escalate this issue or check for any network outages in your area.
I can only do one thing at a time. Which step would you like me to try first?

Let’s start with the simplest step first:

Please check that Airplane Mode is turned off on your phone. You can usually find this in your phone’s quick settings menu or under Settings > Network & Internet.

Let me know once you’ve checked this, and we’ll move to the next step if needed.
Airplane Mode is already turned off on my phone. What's next?

Thank you for checking. Next, please try restarting your phone one more time, but this time, after turning it off, wait about 30 seconds before turning it back on. This can help your phone reconnect to the network after the suspension was lifted.

If you still have no service after this restart, please let me know, and we’ll proceed to the next troubleshooting step.
I restarted my phone as you asked, but I still have no service—there are no bars showing at all.

Thank you for trying that. Since restarting didn’t resolve the issue, let’s move to the next step:

Please remove your SIM card from your phone, wait about 10 seconds, and then reinsert it. If you’re using an eSIM, instead try toggling your mobile network off and then back on (Settings > Network & Internet > Mobile Network > turn off, then turn on).

After doing this, check if your phone regains service. Let me know the result, and we’ll continue troubleshooting if needed.
I removed and reinserted the SIM card as you asked. The SIM status shows as active, but I still have no service and no bars are showing.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your SIM status shows as active but you still have no service, this could indicate a network issue, a SIM card problem, or a device-related issue.

Let’s try one more step:
- If possible, please insert your SIM card into another compatible phone. This will help us determine if the issue is with your SIM card/service or with your phone itself.

If you don’t have another phone available, please let me know. If the SIM also doesn’t work in another phone, or if you can’t test it, I can escalate this issue to our technical team for further investigation.

Please let me know what you’re able to try, and I’ll assist you further!
I don't have another phone available to test the SIM card. What should I do next?

I have escalated your issue to a human agent who will investigate further and assist you directly. They will be able to check for network or SIM problems on our end and help restore your service.

Thank you for your patience—someone from our team will be with you shortly to resolve this.
